title: Rapper MANGM Makes Impressive Return With New Single “Trust Again”
htmlContent:
MANGM is an emerging rapper who has been on an upward trajectory since making his debut back in 2019. An independent artist, he’s already accumulated over 250k streams, and he looks set to build on this further with the release of his new single, “Trust Again”, which arrives alongside a music video directed by ShotByVIP.

Lyrically, “Trust Again” is a continuation of his previous single, “Bonnie & Clyde”, which was released earlier this year. On “Bonnie & Clyde”, we hear the rapper talk about the end of a relationship, whereas “Trust Again” is about moving on and finding love again. With the track’s anthemic singalong hook, its replay value is undeniable and no doubt it will be ingrained into everyone’s head after one listen.

Elaborating further on the meaning behind his new single, MANGM says: “‘Trust Again’ is about the spark when you first meet someone and the feeling that it gives you. I wanted to follow on the story from ‘Bonnie & Clyde’, so I needed a story just as engaging for the listeners. I tried to lift the mood with this track.”

Stay connected with MANGM via Instagram.
